title: ConvAnalysisSummary - Data API
description: Represents the information stored for each run or refresh of Sales Signals. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

AnalysisDate.description: The date when the actual data analysis was done, accounting for the delay between the refresh start time and the data analysis.

DataModelVersion.description: The data model version generated by Hawking.

Error.description: The error message sent by Hawking when a refresh fails.

FlowIdentifier.description: The UUID used to track the Hawking flow ID.

RefreshDate.description: The date when the admin started the refresh of their ECI data for processing.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of the refresh or run. Possible values are: FAILED PARTIALLY_FAILED PROCESSING SUCCESS

TotalCalls.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TotalCalls.description: The total number of calls that were analyzed for Sales Signals.

TotalMentions.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TotalMentions.description: The total number of mentions or keywords that were analyzed.

special_access_rules: Users need the Sales Signals permission set and the Sales Signals feature must be enabled.
